metric_contract.unit: distinct platform x equal-area cell x UTC day, summed by month
metric_contract.policy: No target-region fitting, parameter selection, exclusion based on outcomes, or promotion after scoring. Missing/corrupt sources fail the region; no invented zeros. Report every case, including failures.

independent_validation.selection: All returned 2023 Wildfire polygons intersecting bounding box; no manual event selection
independent_validation.interpretation: Reference-event corroboration against independently mapped postfire footprints, not pixel recall, precision, exact ignition latency or burned-area estimation. Retain incomplete/invalid reference events.

coverage_pilot.source: NOAA-20 operational VIIRS I-band E-FIRE and matching terrain-corrected imagery geolocation
coverage_pilot.selection: All same-date granules whose full geolocated pixels enter the box; retain cloud, unknown, missing, bowtie, water and fire separately
coverage_pilot.limitations: NOAA operational QA does not verify NASA Aqua or VJ114IMG standard-product observation masks. This is a selected-day pilot, not historical/global QA completion.

integrity_note: Locally frozen first-look geographic evaluation; not independently blinded or externally timestamped. Freeze metadata alone is not tamper-proof.
